name: search_mathlib
description: 在固定 mathlib 的 Lean 源码中搜索正则表达式，返回至多 100 行。

name: read_mathlib
description: 读取固定 mathlib 中一个 Mathlib/...lean 文件的指定行。

name: read_task_input
description: Read an explicitly frozen task document by ID; no other local files are accessible.

name: read_yui
description: Read declared Yui rules/templates; no tests, historical runs or personal files.

name: check_artifact
description: Check a JSON artifact against the explicit stage contract; this is not automatic mathematical certification.

name: submit_artifact
description: Submit a JSON artifact after its stage checks.

name: report_obstacle
description: Stop this stage honestly on a substantive or suspected proof gap, unavailable source, or input conflict. JSON fields: status, location, explanation, basis, partial_progress. Status must be SUBSTANTIVE_GAP, SUSPECTED_GAP, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or INPUT_CONFLICT. Difficulty alone is not a mathematical error.

name: probe_library
description: Query a proved Mathlib theorem and its exact signature/axioms in the offline sandbox. Returns located evidence for an M source; the mathematical statement and applicability still require review.

name: read_draft
description: Read a JSON pointer in your own same-stage candidate after an actual structural check. No other file/stage is accessible; choose a narrow pointer for large objects.
